ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel distribution across approximately 98% of the visible ventral surface, resulting in a very low macro-level contrast ratio.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of approximately 50-60 degrees and deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying amplitudes (1-5% of lobe width) present across the entire span of the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curvature transitioning to sharp, upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the extreme lateral tips (left and right) of the fluke, consistent with localized scarring or encrustations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregularity and jaggedness along the entire trailing edge boundary; focal white scarring localized at the distal tips.
